data.name: Erfan
data.gender_notes: Erfan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Erfan means 'experienced' or 'knowledgeable' in Persian language. It is derived from the word 'arafan' which means 'to know'. Erfan is a name that signifies wisdom and tranquility. It is a name for a boy who is believed to be experienced and knowledgeable, one who has gained deep insights and understanding through experience.
data.spiritual_meaning: Erfan is a spiritual name that signifies the journey of self-discovery and enlightenment. It is a name for a boy who is on the path of spiritual growth and is seeking to deepen his understanding of the world around him and the divine within him.
data.etymology: Erfan belongs to the Persian linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Experienced, knowledgeable, wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erfan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
